pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark regions exhibit sub-polygonal geometry with moderately sharp edge gradients. Patch spatial area is maximal in the dorsal-lateral region and decreases in size toward the ventral and posterior segments.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pelage forming multi-directional junction nodes (primarily tri-radial). Corridor thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, separating the distinct patch boundaries.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal ridge presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a single avian symbiont (oxpecker) on the lower-left lateral flank region.
